name: ChatNest AI Chatbot for WooCommerce
author: chatnestuk

sections.description:
ChatNest is an AI customer support chatbot built for online stores. Give it your catalog, shipping info, return policy and FAQs, and it answers shoppers immediately — on every page of your WooCommerce site.

Why ChatNest for WooCommerce

  • Answers only from your store. Paste your product info, shipping rates, return window and store policies. The bot never invents answers about pricing or stock.
  • Branded to match your site. Custom name, avatar emoji, welcome message and brand colour — set from the ChatNest dashboard.
  • Human takeover. All conversations land in your live inbox. Reply as a human inside the chat when a shopper needs a person.
  • No API keys, no technical upkeep. The AI engine is fully managed. You configure everything from one dashboard.
  • Free to start. 1 chatbot, 100 AI messages/day, live inbox, store-wide widget — no credit card required.

What this plugin does

This plugin is a one-line install wrapper: enter your ChatNest embed token once in Settings → ChatNest AI Chatbot, and the widget script is added to every page of your WooCommerce shop. Change your chatbot’s colour, product info or instructions later and the widget updates instantly — no re-paste, no redeploy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the chatnest-ai-chatbot-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen. (WooCommerce must be active!)
  3. Go to Settings → ChatNest AI Chatbot.
  4. Create a free chatbot at chatnest.uk, open Chatbots → Embed, and copy the 32-character token.
  5. Paste the token into the plugin settings and save. The widget now appears throughout your store.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce to use this?

Yes. This plugin is the WooCommerce-specific version of ChatNest. For a standard WordPress site use the ChatNest AI Chatbot plugin instead.

How do I add product information to the chatbot?

In the ChatNest dashboard, paste your store’s product range, shipping rates, return window and any other info. The bot answers from exactly that content.

Can I use the same chatbot on multiple sites?

Yes — the same token can be pasted into the plugin on as many sites as you like. Changes apply everywhere at once.

Where is my store’s data stored?

ChatNest is hosted in the UK (chatnest.uk). See the ChatNest privacy policy for full details.
